The code generated for the tetris game had a bug in handling multiple line clearance and chatgpt can't fix it after several round of prompts. I had to fix it myself. 
the buggy code:
def clear_lines(grid):
    lines_cleared = 0
    for i in range(len(grid) - 1, -1, -1):
        if all(grid[i]):
            del grid[i]
            grid.insert(0, [0] * (SCREEN_WIDTH // BLOCK_SIZE))
            lines_cleared += 1
    return lines_cleared
the fix (chatGPT-4o failed to provide):
   for i in range(len(grid)):
